subject: Onboarding assembly: schedule, confirmed attendees, and prework
messages:
----- Message 1 -----
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@cerebrahealth.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@cerebrahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding assembly: schedule, confirmed attendees, and prework

Hi Olivia / Sam —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for inference serving. We're excited to get the implementation cadence going. To make the first session productive, please confirm one of these two 60-minute windows next week (we'll lock the calendar once you confirm):

- Tuesday, Jun 17 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wednesday, Jun 18 — 14:00–15:00 PT

Agenda (draft attached: kickoff-agenda-v1.docx):
- 10m introductions & success criteria owners
- 15m architecture & access requirements (SSO, VPC, data paths)
- 20m implementation plan: milestones, roles, repo/accesses
- 10m immediate next steps & responsibilities
- 5m Q&A

Please also confirm attendees from your side (we've tentatively added Sam as PM and a technical lead). If you'll have an integration/infra lead who needs deeper SAML or firewall discussions, include them now so we can extend the agenda.

I've attached the intake questionnaire (RDW-intake-questions.pdf) — if you can fill the highlighted infrastructure and SSO sections beforehand, that saves time in the session.

Proposed Redwood attendees:
- Grace O'Connor — CS lead (host)
- Monica Patel — Solutions engineer (architecture & access)
- Jonas Weber — Platform engineer (runtime, deployment & network)

If either proposed time doesn't work, share two alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

----- Message 2 -----
From: Olivia Martin <olivia@cerebrahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cerebrahealth.com>, implementations@cerebrahealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 18:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding assembly: schedule, confirmed attendees, and prework

Hi Grace —

Thanks — Wednesday, Jun 18 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our team. Confirming attendees from Cerebra:
- Olivia Martin — Head of Product (owner)
- Sam Patel — PM (coord)
- Priya Desai — Lead SRE (infra & SSO) <priya.desai@cerebrahealth.com>
- integrations@cerebrahealth.com (we'll include our integration specialist on the invite)

I've attached the SAML metadata file for Priya (cerebra-saml-metadata.xml) — she'll want to pair with Monica on the SSO portion.

We can fill the intake PDF before the meeting; I'll have Priya complete the network/SAML sections by EOD Mon, Jun 16.

Two quick asks:
1) Can you add a Zoom link and the calendar invite once it's booked?
2) If there's an internal owner for audit logs / data retention (legal/compliance), please flag them in case we need a separate session.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Martin
Head of Product, Cerebra Health
olivia@cerebrahealth.com

Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding assembly: schedule, confirmed attendees, and prework

Team — forwarding Olivia's confirmation. Confirmed slot: Wed Jun 18 14:00 PT. Action items before the session:

- Monica: pair with Priya on SAML and SSO. Please review the attached metadata (cerebra-saml-metadata.xml) and note any questions for the meeting. (Owner)
- Jonas: prepare a 10min runtime/deployment slide showing our recommended Dedicated vs Hosted routing for their expected throughput. Keep it high-level + an ops checklist. (Owner)
- Rishi: will you own the attendance for legal/compliance if they ask about retention/audit logs? If not, recommend who we should loop.

Also, I'm thinking we should extend the architecture section to 25m and reduce implementation plan to 15m since Priya's joining and SSO will take time. Does that sound right?

Proposed updated agenda:
- 10m intros & success criteria
- 25m architecture & SSO (Monica + Priya)
- 15m implementation milestones & roles (Jonas)
- 5m immediate next steps
- 5m Q&A

Please reply-all with any objections. I'll draft the calendar invite once we confirm the agenda.

Thanks,
Grace
